demo.title: governed-trade.sh
demo.code:
# What can I trade, and what does the price gate see for it right now?
bankr prompt "using the quaestor-trading skill, what can I trade and what does the market evidence say?"

# A governed quote: the floor it guarantees, measured against two independent price sources
bankr prompt "quote 2 USDC of dAAPLx through quaestor and show me the gate's verdict"

# With an agent key: quote -> preview -> execute, inside caps only the owner can change
bankr prompt "buy 2 USDC of dAAPLx through quaestor"
# -> settled, with a transaction signature. Ask for 20 and it reports PER_TRADE_CAP_EXCEEDED

# Is a quote from ANY venue fair? ($0.005 over x402, USDC on Base via Bankr x402 Cloud)
bankr prompt "check this quote with quaestor quote-check: 5 USDC for 1000000 raw units of AAPLx"
# -> off-market: that floor implies ~$498 a share against an observed ~$335

setup: Add the MCP server: `add an MCP server named "quaestor" at https://quaestor-stocks.onrender.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). With no key it serves the eight tools that read — instruments, venues, market evidence, prices, quotes, policy preview, orders, portfolio — and the execute tool is absent.
To execute, store the agent key as a secure variable and send it as a header: `X-API-Key: {{QUAESTOR_KEY}}`. Never put the key in the URL, in chat or in a tool argument.
The hosted hub is Solana devnet with live execution and small caps (5 USDC a trade, 25 a day). It is a free instance and can take up to a minute to wake.
To trade under your own limits, run your own hub and governor: https://github.com/N-45div/Quaestor (`npm run services:stocks`).
Optional paid checks settle over x402: USDC on Base through Bankr x402 Cloud, or USDC on Solana through PayAI. Governed quotes already include the check for free.
